summary: Recovered the existing audio-to-text implementation instead of rebuilding it. The deployed human entrypoint is https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/pages/voice/ backed by pages/voice/index.html + pages/voice/transcriber-worker.js. It captures microphone audio with MediaRecorder, converts to mono 16 kHz, and transcribes in a Web Worker using @huggingface/transformers 3.8.1 with Xenova/whisper-small, WASM, q8, Spanish transcription. A separate server-side study/class STT also exists as active Supabase Edge Function study-transcribe-v1 v6 using Whisper large-v3-family inference and persisting authenticated session chunks. Historical database receipts show 216 ready whisper-large-v3 legacy chunks with latest finished 2026-09-11T14:11:11.059Z. This proves prior successful STT operation, not current end-to-end live operation today.
